subject: Multi-cloud procurement gateway: vendor intake & PO path for CloudForge
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@cloudforge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudforge.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor intake & procurement path for AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace listing

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the call this morning — excited about moving CloudForge onto Redwood's marketplace listings (we support AWS/GCP/Azure images). Per our procurement team, they'd like a consolidated intake form and the specific PO routing steps so we can align finance and legal here.

I've attached our standard procurement form and a first-pass SOW for the marketplace enablement work. Can you confirm:

- Which PO template/redwood vendor code we should use for marketplace listing fees/integration services?
- Is there a preferred procurement contact or portal for submitting POs (DocuSign vs. emailed PO)?
- Any specific SOC2 / encryption evidence your procurement team requires ahead of a purchase order?

Also copying our procurement alias so they have visibility. If easier, we can do a quick 20-minute sync to run through intake fields.

Thanks,

Asha Menon
Head of Partnerships | CloudForge, Inc.
asha.menon@cloudforge.com
[attachment: CloudForge_Procurement_Form_v2.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: CF-SOW-Draft-20261111.docx (DOCX)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor intake & procurement path for AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace listing

Hi Asha — appreciate the materials and great conversation earlier. Looping in Vanessa (Marketplace Program Ops) and Ben (Finance/vendor activation) to help with intake and PO routing.

Quick answers and next steps:

- PO template: use the attached PO_TEMPLATE from Redwood (we'll attach in reply). For marketplace listing fees, code: MKTPL-23 (finance will map at intake).
- Submission: procurement should open a ticket in our Vendor Intake JIRA (PROC-812). DocuSign for SOWs is preferred for statements of work; POs may be emailed to vendor-ops@redwood.ai but must reference the JIRA ticket.
- Evidence: we require a current SOC 2 Type II report and the standard encryption attestation (AES-256 in transit + at rest) — redacted SOC reports are fine.

Vanessa — can you confirm the onboarding checklist and whether we need a separate Marketplace Vendor Agreement for multi-cloud images? Ben — we'll need an estimate for onboarding costs to add to the draft PO so CloudForge knows the expected upfront charge.

Asha, attaching: PO_Template_Redwood_v1.xlsx and a short intake checklist. If you can populate the procurement form and upload to the JIRA ticket, that speeds things up.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
[attachment: PO_Template_Redwood_v1.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@cloudforge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudforge.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor intake & procurement path for AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace listing

Thanks Kimberly — attached is the procurement form filled out by our finance lead and a redlined SOW where we've clarified the integration milestones.

We opened JIRA PROC-812 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-812) and uploaded the PDFs. SOC 2 Type II report is sensitive; we'll provide a redacted copy via the secure portal (is there a preferred upload destination?).

About PO mechanics: CloudForge's procurement prefers to issue a PO to vendor-ops@redwood.ai and route SOW via DocuSign. The PO will reference the JIRA ticket and the MKTPL-23 code you provided.

Let me know if Redwood needs a supplier W9 or any other tax paperwork.

Regards,

Asha
[attachment: CloudForge_Procurement_Form_v2-filled.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: CF-SOW-Draft-20261111-redlined.docx (DOCX)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@cloudforge.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor intake & procurement path for AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace listing

Hi Asha — thanks for uploading the docs and opening PROC-812. Quick checklist and next actions from Redwood Ops / Finance:

1) Procurement intake accepted — we have the filled form and redlined SOW. Please upload the redacted SOC2 to the secure vendor portal: https://redwood-secure-upload.example.com (temporary token valid 48 hrs).
2) Finance needs CloudForge's W9 and vendor bank details (or EFT form) to provision vendor code. Please attach to the JIRA ticket.
3) Onboarding estimate: Ben confirmed an initial onboarding fee of $7,500 (one-time) to cover marketplace integration + listing QA. We will include this in the PO template and route to legal for review of the SOW.
4) DocuSign: we'll send the final SOW via DocuSign once legal signs off. Expected timeline: 7–10 business days from receipt of SOC2 and W9.

Action items for CloudForge: upload redacted SOC2 and W9 to PROC-812; confirm bank details and whether they prefer USD invoicing.

If agreeable, we can schedule a 15-min cutover sync next week to cover image pushes and runtime testing windows (low-latency regions: us-west-2 and europe-west1).

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Program Ops | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
